W przypadku, gdy Wykonawca będzie w gotowości do oddania w terminie 80 dni od podpisania Umowy większego procentu przerobu niż określone 10% wartości prac przewidzianych do etapu I, to zwiększenie ww. procentu jest możliwe pod warunkiem posiadania przez Zamawiającego odpowiednich środków w budżecie (co po wyrażeniu zgody przez Zamawiającego będzie wymagało zawarcia aneksu). title: Germany – Miscellaneous health services – "Medizinische Versorgung gem. § 62 Asylgesetz (AsylG)" - Los 1 und "Soziale Dienste inkl. Gewaltschutzkoordination und Freizeitpädagogik - Los 2" für den Standorts Osnabrück (LAB NI)
description: Für die LAB NI sollen die Auftragnehmer die Med. Versorgung in Form einer Sanitätsstation und ärztlicher Versorgung analog einer hausärztlichen Versorgung sowie der Durchführung von Erstuntersuchungen (Los 1) und die Sozialen Dienste inkl. Gewaltschutzkoordination und freizeitpädagogischem Angebot (Los 2) am Standort Osnabrück ausgeschrieben und vergeben werden. Der Standort Osnabrück liegt im verkehrstechnisch gut angebundenen Stadtteil Westerberg der Stadt Osnabrück. Die Einrichtung ist an den öffentlichen Personennahverkehr angeschlossen und vom Bahnhof und von der Innenstadt direkt erreichbar. Auf der Liegenschaft befinden sich neben der LAB NI das Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge (BAMF) sowie zwei unabhängige Verfahrensberatungen. Einzelne Dienstleistungen wie z. B. der Sicherheitsdienst, die med. Versorgung durch die Sanitätsstation, die Sozialen Dienste, Verpflegung und Reinigung werden durch externe Auftragnehmer erbracht. Auf der Liegenschaft befindet sich ein Unterkunftsgebäude mit einem Schutzbereich für Frauen, einer großen modernen Kantine, einer Sanitätsstation mit Erstuntersuchungsbereich und einer Sporthalle. In weiteren Gebäuden befinden sich Einrichtungen wie z. B. eine Kinderbetreuung und eine Begegnungsstätte mit verschiedenen Freizeitangeboten. Darüber hinaus befindet sich auf der Liegenschaft eine Infektionsambulanz, die nicht der LAB NI angegliedert ist und externe Patienten behandelt. Der Standort Osnabrück verfügt über eine maximale Unterbringungskapazität von 729 Personen. In begründeten Ausnahmefällen können Vorgaben des Landes darüber hinaus dazu führen, dass weitere Personen über die maximale Aufnahmekapazität hinaus aufgenommen werden. Aufgrund von regel-mäßigen Schwankungen kann keine genaue Angabe zur täglichen Anzahl von Zugängen und Abgängen und somit zur Anzahl der regelmäßig zu versorgenden Personen gemacht werden. Darüber hinaus ist eine Versorgung auch bei temporärer Überbelegung (vorübergehende Überbelegung um max. 5 % für bis zu 2 Wochen) und/oder in besonderen Fällen zu gewährleisten. In diesem Fall er-folgt die Abrechnung der Leistung entsprechend dem Angebotsblatt. Nähere Einzelheiten zu Art und Umfang des Auftrags sind der Leistungsbeschreibung - Fachlicher Teil (Teil B) zu entnehmen.

title: Germany – Medical equipments – Erweiterung und Sanierung Klinikum Altmühlfranken Weißenburg 1. BA (Unterbauabschnitt 1a)
description: Bereits im Jahr 2008 wurde das Klinikum Altmühlfranken in Weißenburg um ein Fachärztezentrum erweitert. Jetzt soll das Klinikum - baualtersbedingt und mit Defiziten im Flächenangebot und der Funktionalität - in zwei Bauabschnitten generalsaniert und erweitert werden. Bestandteil dieses Antrags Bau und Ausstattungsplanung ist der 1. Bauabschnitt BA1 und hier die zwei Teilbauabschnitte BA1A und BA1E. BA1 – 1. Bauabschnitt Im ersten Bauabschnitt wird der bestehende Funktionstrakt durch einen Neubau ersetzt (BA1A) und im Anschluss für Nachnutzungen saniert bzw. umgebaut (BA1B). Ergänzend hierzu wird die bestehende Eingangshalle erweitert und erneuert (BA1E). BA1A - Neubau: Der Neubau im Süd-Osten des Grundstücks ist als ein kompakter Baukörper mit idealtypischer Grundrissorganisation und direkter Anbindung an den Haupteingang vorgesehen. Im Neubau werden sämtliche hochinstallierte Kernfunktionen des Klinikums konzentriert untergebracht: - UG: AEMP, Labor, Umkleiden, Archiv, Wäschetauschstelle, Technik - EG: ZEA/ZNA mit neuer Liegendkrankenzufahrt und ambulantem Eingang, Radiologie, Endoskopie, Funktionsdiagnostik, Entbindung - 1.OG: OP-Abteilung mit Same-Day- Surgery, Intensivmedizin, Bereitschaftsdienst - 2.OG: Technik Die Grundriss sieht eine mittig gelegene öffentliche Erschließungsachse in Ost-West-Ausrichtung vor, an der die einzelnen Funktionsbereiche und die vertikale Erschließung mit Aufzugskern angelagert sind. Im 1.Obergeschoss wird zudem ein Innenhof ausgebildet, der die Belichtung der entsprechenden Abteilungen sicherstellt. In diesem maßgeschneiderten Neubau werden optimale Prozesse des Krankenhausbetriebs erreicht und die primären Funktionsdefizite des Bestandes beseitigt. Durch die autarke Errichtung des neuen Funktionstraktes BA1A kann der laufende Betrieb im Bestand unbeeinträchtigt fortgeführt werden. BA1E - Neubau/Sanierung Eingangshalle: Durch den Neubau und seinen Anschluss an den Bestand wird gleichzeitig eine neue Eingangssituation und damit ein neuer zukunftweisender städtebaulicher Auftritt des Klinikums geschaffen. Hierzu wird die bestehende Eingangshalle auf Eingangsebene erweitert/begradigt und damit ein klarer eindeutiger Zugang ausgebildet. Die Eingangshalle an zentraler Stelle des Klinikums wird kernsaniert und hier allgemeine Funktionen untergebracht: - EG: Serviceeinrichtungen mit Empfang/Poststelle, Seelsorge- und Sozialdienstbereich - OGs: Erschließung mit Aufenthaltsbereichen Während dieser Sanierung kann ein provisorischer Haupteingang von Norden her am Übergang zum Neubau gelegt werden. BA1B - Sanierung Bestand, Ausblick (nicht Bestandteil dieser BAP): Nach Umzug der Kernfunktionen des Klinikums in den errichteten Neubau BA1A wird der ursprüngliche Funktionstrakt entsprechend umgebaut und folgende Funktionen hier verortet: - UG: Ver-/Entsorgung, Lagerhaltung, Haus- und Transportdienst, Wartung/Reparatur, Abfallentsorgung, Arzneimittel, Technik - EG: Physikalische Therapie, Arztdienst, Bereitschaftsdienst, Speisenversorgung mit Besucher-/Bediensteten-Cafeteria mit Außenbereich - 1.OG: Arztdienst, Verwaltung - 2.OG: Andachtsraum, Technik Im Rahmen der Kernsanierung wird als größerer baulicher Eingriff ein Innenhof im 1.OG zwecks Belichtung der angrenzenden Funktionen ausgebildet. Die gesamte Sanierung kann in einem Zuge erfolgen, lediglich 4 / 7 die bestehende Speisenversorgung im 1.UG bleibt zunächst erhalten und wird nach Fertigstellung der neuen Speisenversorgung im EG zurück- und entsprechend umgebaut. BA2 - 2. Bauabschnitt, Ausblick (nicht Bestandteil dieser BAP) Im zweiten Bauabschnitt soll im Klinikum Altmühlfranken Weißenburg dann die Pflege modernisiert werden. Hierzu ergeben sich zwei Möglichkeiten: - Sanierung und Erweiterung der bestehenden Pflegehäuser - Neubauten Pflege neben dem neu errichteten Funktionstrakt BA1A, der in seiner Positionierung und dem Grundrisslayout einen idealen Anschluss an neue Pflegekörper zulässt.

title: Germany – Business development consultancy services – 10022598-Short-Term Expert Pools to support negotiations and implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA)
description: Background: Although many of the world"s fastest-growing economies are in Africa, trade among African countries remains limited. The continent mostly exports raw materials and agricultural products, while it imports machinery, equipment, and food mainly from outside Africa. The African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), which is one of the African Union"s (AU) flagship projects for the implementation of its Agenda 2063, aims to change this. It is expected that, with the introduction of the free trade zone, intra- African trade will be 15% to 25% higher by 2040 (UNECA). The AfCFTA agreement has been signed by 54 of the 55 African Union Member States (MS) and became effective under international law in May 2019. The full implementation of the AfCFTA will lead to a continental single market of more than 1.4 billion people with an aggregate GDP exceeding USD 2 trillion. Our Approach: The GIZ implemented project "Support to the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) II" cofinanced by the BMZ and the EU, seeks to improve framework conditions for the realisation of the AfCFTA and supports the outstanding negotiations and the implementation of the AfCFTA. For this, the programme supports the African Union, specifically the Department for Economic Development, Trade, Tourism, Industry, Minerals (ETTIM) and the AfCFTA Secretariat at the continental level in the coordination of AfCFTA implementation. On the regional level the programme cooperates with Regional Economic Communities (RECs), specifically EAC (East African Community), ECOWAS (Economic Community for West African States) and SADC (South African Development Community, plus additional RECs based on request). The programme also supports Member States (Ethiopia, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tunisia, Zambia, plus additional Member States based on request) by working with national institutions, like trade ministries and customs, to implement the agreement. Lastly, the programme works closely with private sector and civil society actors to increase trade under the AfCFTA. Together with the named partners, the programme covers interventions across all technical areas of the AfCFTA. The EU co-financed part of the programme, the EU Technical Assistance Facility, operates as a multi-partner contribution agreement between the European Commission, GIZ (lead implementing agency), Expertise France, and FIAP. A Project Management Unit, which is housed in the AfCFTA Secretariat, oversees the implementation of the programme and the execution of activities.

buyer: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
title: Germany – Business development consultancy services – 10007377-Strategic Environmental and Social Assessment (SESA) of the oil and gas sector to be carried out in the DRC
description: The "Strengthening environmental and social governance in the extractive sector" component, co-financed by FONAREDD from CAFI (Central Africa Forest Initiative) resources and BMZ, will be implemented by GIZ for the Ministry of the Environment and Sustainable Development (MEDD) of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The project is being carried out by the Integrated Economic Development of the Mining Sector Project (DISM II), in partnership with the Congolese Environment Agency (ACE), which is responsible for environmental and social assessments and for monitoring and controlling the implementation of ESMPs at national level. Following a 1st Strategic Environmental and Social Study of the mining sector in the DRC in 2010, and in view of the changing international context, it is planned, in agreement with the donor and partners, to launch Strategic Environmental and Social Studies (SESES) for the key sector of mining and hydrocarbons, in order to analyse the expected positive and negative impacts of their development at national level. This work will make it possible to identify good and bad practices in the provinces affected; and in partnership with the various partners and civil society, to propose recommendations integrating REDD+ standards into the extractive sectors. Finally, best practice guides will also be drawn up, based on the experience gained with dialogue platforms in the extractive sector. Adaptations of the various texts relating to the legal and regulatory provisions linked to the environmental and social governance of the extractive sectors will also be proposed in order to be consistent with REDD+ standards and the principles of the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI).

title: Romania – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Echipamente de laborator 6 loturi
description: Universitatea din București lansează Licitația deschisă pentru achiziționarea de echipamente de laborator (distilator de apa, agitatoare magnetice, autoclave pentru digestie acida, aparat Real Time PCR, Ultracongelator -86°C) necesare desfășurării activităților de cercetare din cadrul proiectului de cercetare nr. 17CoEx/2026 cu titlul Centru Național Multidisciplinar de Excelență pentru Combaterea Rezistenței la Tratamentele Antiinfecțioase, implementat în Universitatea din București. Distilatorul automat de apă este necesar pentru obținerea apei distilate de înaltă puritate utilizate la prepararea reactivilor, soluțiilor tampon și mediilor de lucru, reducând riscul contaminării experimentelor și asigurând reproductibilitatea analizelor. Plita magnetica cu încălzire cu patru poziții sunt necesare pentru prepararea simultană a soluțiilor și reactivilor, desfășurarea reacțiilor chimice și menținerea controlată a temperaturii în timpul experimentelor, contribuind la creșterea eficienței activităților de laborator. Autoclavele (vasele de reacție pentru digestie acidă) sunt indispensabile pentru digestia probelor biologice și de mediu în condiții de temperatură și presiune ridicate, etapă necesară înaintea determinărilor de compoziție elementală și a altor analize instrumentale. Aparatul Real-Time PCR este esențial pentru analiza expresiei genice, identificarea și cuantificarea acizilor nucleici și realizarea experimentelor de biologie moleculară prevăzute în proiect, contribuind la obținerea unor rezultate rapide, sensibile și reproductibile. Ultracongelatoarele (-86°C) sunt necesare pentru conservarea pe termen lung, în condiții optime, a probelor biologice, colecțiilor de microorganisme, ADN, ARN, liniilor celulare și altor materiale biologice rezultate din activitățile de cercetare, menținând integritatea acestora pe întreaga durată a proiectului și ulterior. Agitatoarele magnetice cu încălzire electrică permit desfășurarea experimentelor care necesită control precis al temperaturii și al vitezei de agitare, fiind utilizate pentru prepararea reactivilor, sinteze și reacții chimice specifice activităților de cercetare desfășurate în cadrul centrului. Lotul 1 Distilator de apa - 1 buc. Lotul 2 Plita magnetica cu incalzire cu patru pozitii - 2 buc. Lotul 3 Autoclave (vas de reacție pentru digestie acidă) - 2 buc. Lotul 4 Aparat Real-Time PCR - 1 buc. Lotul 5 Ultracongelator -86°C cu accesorii - 2 buc. Lotul 6 Agitator magnetic cu incalzire electrica - 4 buc. Numar de zile pana la care se pot solicita clarificari inainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor: 17 zile. Autoritatea contractanta va raspunde in mod clar si complet tuturor solicitarilor de clarificare/informatiilor suplimentare in a 11-a zi inainte de termenul limita de depunere a ofertelor.

description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η ανάθεση του αποκλειστικού δικαιώματος εκτέλεσης και εκμετάλλευσης δημόσιων τακτικών αστικών και υπεραστικών οδικών μεταφορών επιβατών με λεωφορείο στην Περιφέρεια Ιονίων Νήσων μέσω σύμβασης παραχώρησης υπηρεσιών δημόσιων επιβατικών μεταφορών κατ’ εφαρμογή του κανονισμού 1370/2007. Συγκεκριμένα, το αντικείμενο της σύμβασης υποδιαιρείται σε δύο (2) Τμήματα ως εξής: ΤΜΗΜΑ 1: «Παραχώρηση δικαιώματος αποκλειστικής εκμετάλλευσης δημόσιων τακτικών υπεραστικών μεταφορών επιβατών με λεωφορείο στην Περιφέρεια Ιονίων Νήσων», εκτιμώμενης αξίας 169.500.000,00 € πλέον ΦΠΑ [ήτοι, 16.950.000 € ετησίως, για δέκα (10) έτη] και ΤΜΗΜΑ 2: «Παραχώρηση δικαιώματος αποκλειστικής εκμετάλλευσης δημόσιων τακτικών αστικών μεταφορών επιβατών με λεωφορείο στην Περιφέρεια Ιονίων Νήσων», εκτιμώμενης αξίας 52.500.000,00 € πλέον ΦΠΑ [ήτοι, 5.250.000 € ετησίως, για δέκα (10) έτη] Η εκτιμώμενη αξία της σύμβασης, ανέρχεται συνολικά στο ποσό των 222.000.000,00 € μη συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ 13 % (εκτιμώμενη αξία συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ: € 250.860.000,00). Συμπεριλαμβανομένου δικαιώματος προαίρεσης, εφόσον ασκηθεί υπό τους όρους και τις προϋποθέσεις της παρ. 4 του άρθρου 4 του Κανονισμού (ΕΚ) 1370/2007, η εκτιμώμενη αξία της σύμβασης δύναται να ανέλθει στο ποσό των 333.000.000,00 € μη συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ 13 % (εκτιμώμενη αξία συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ: € 376.290.000,00). Η διάρκεια της σύμβασης ορίζεται σε δέκα (10) έτη για το κάθε Τμήμα, από την ημερομηνία έναρξης παροχής συγκοινωνιακού έργου όπως θα καθοριστεί στη σύμβαση, σύμφωνα με τα αναγραφόμενα στην παράγραφο 6.2 της παρούσας Διακήρυξης. Υπάρχει δυνατότητα παράτασης της διάρκειας της σύμβασης, κατά τη διακριτική ευχέρεια του αναθέτοντος φορέα, για έως πέντε (5) επιπλέον έτη αποκλειστικά υπό τους όρους και τις προϋποθέσεις της παραγράφου 4 του άρθρου 4 του κανονισμού (ΕΚ) 1370/2007 και σύμφωνα με τις Ανακοινώσεις 2014/C 92/01 και 2023/C 222/01 της Ευρωπαϊκής Επιτροπής σχετικά με ερμηνευτικές οδηγίες του κανονισμού (ΕΚ) 1370/2007. Ημερομηνία αποσφράγισης των προσφορών: 22.09.2026 Τετάρτη 15:00:00 (τοπική).

title: Romania – Electric buses – Achiziționare de mijloace de transport fără emisii de CO2, inclusiv stații de încărcare
description: Obiectul contractului de achiziție publică îl reprezintă furnizarea a 10 autobuze electrice noi pentru transport public de călători și a 3 stații de încărcare rapidă (montaj, integrare, configurare, testare și probe funcționale, punere în funcțiune,I nstruirea personalului, autorizarea personalului, efectuarea formalităților necesare înmatriculării și punerii în circulație, remedierea eventualelor neconformități constatate în etapa de verificare și recepție.), în cadrul proiectului:„Mobilitate urbană – construire autobază și achiziționare mijloace de transport public fără emisii de CO₂, inclusiv stații de încărcare, în orașul Buftea, județul Ilfov”, finanțat prin Programul Regional București–Ilfov 2021–2027, Prioritatea 4 – „O regiune cu mobilitate ridicată”, Obiectiv specific 2.8 – „Promovarea mobilității urbane multimodale sustenabile, ca parte a tranziției către o economie cu zero emisii de dioxid de carbon”, din Fondul European de Dezvoltare Regională (FEDR), în cadrul apelului de proiecte PR BI/P4/4.1/4.2/1/2025. Contractul vizează achiziționarea și punerea în funcțiune a: 10 autobuze electrice noi destinate transportului public urban de călători; 3 stații de încărcare rapidă compatibile cu autobuzele furnizate; echipamentelor, accesoriilor, software-ului și componentelor necesare funcționării integrate a sistemului de transport electric; serviciilor conexe de livrare, punere în funcțiune, testare, instruire a personalului și asigurare a garanției. Prin implementarea proiectului și achiziționarea mijloacelor de transport public nepoluante se urmărește: • creșterea atractivității transportului public și a gradului de utilizare a acestuia în cadrul distribuției modale a deplasărilor urbane; • reducerea emisiilor de gaze cu efect de seră și contribuția la obiectivele de neutralitate climatică; • diminuarea poluării atmosferice și fonice generate de traficul urban; • promovarea transportului public urban ca alternativă sustenabilă la utilizarea autoturismului personal; • creșterea accesibilității populației la principalele puncte de interes din orașul Buftea; • eficientizarea serviciului de transport public prin reducerea timpilor de deplasare și îmbunătățirea calității serviciului; • reducerea costurilor sociale și economice generate de congestia traficului urban; • dezvoltarea unui sistem de mobilitate urbană modern, eficient energetic și adaptat cerințelor tranziției verzi. Rezultatele estimate prin implementarea contractului includ: • introducerea în circulație a unui parc de autobuze electrice moderne, fără emisii locale de CO₂; • dezvoltarea infrastructurii necesare alimentării rapide a vehiculelor electrice; • reducerea consumului de combustibili fosili în transportul public local; • îmbunătățirea confortului, siguranței și accesibilității pentru utilizatorii serviciului public de transport; • creșterea fiabilității și eficienței operaționale a serviciului de transport public; • alinierea sistemului de mobilitate urbană al orașului Buftea la obiectivele europene privind mobilitatea durabilă și protecția mediului. Termene pentru depunerea/ raspunsul la solicitarile de clarificari/informatii suplimentare: A. În conformitate cu prevederile art.160 alin.(1) din Legea nr.98/2016 cu modificările şi completările ulterioare, termenul limita până la care orice operator economic interesat are dreptul de a solicita clarificari sau informatii suplimentare in legatura cu documentaţia de atribuire este de 18 zile înainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor. B. . buyer: Institutul de Fonoaudiologie si Chirurgie Functionala - O.R.L. Prof. Dr. D. Hociota
title: Romania – Magnetic resonance imaging equipment – Furnizare sistem de imagistica medicala RMN 3 Tesla si servicii conexe
description: In prezent, Institutul de Fonoaudiologie şi Chirurgie Funcţională O.R.L.–„Prof. Dr. Dorin Hociotă” are externalizate serviciile de imagistica medicala prin Rezonanta Magnetica Nucleara, ceea ce duce la costuri suplimentare din partea Institutului, disconfortul creat pacientilor care trebuie sa se deplaseze pana la clinicile de imagistica medicala, cat si imposibilitatea efectuarii in regim de urgenta a examinarilor imagistice. Având în vedere strategia de dezvoltare și modernizare a infrastructurii Institutului de Fonoaudiologie şi Chirurgie Funcţională O.R.L.–„Prof. Dr. Dorin Hociotă” şi ţinând seama de evoluţia tehnologică din imagistica medicala cu includerea unor softuri de inteligenţă artificială pentru un suport în diagnostic, este imperios necesar achizitionarea unei aparaturi de imagistica medicala de ultima generatie, pentru lărgirea numerică a bazei tehnice prin achizitionarea unui sistem de imagistica medicala RMN 3T fără de care vom fi limitaţi în a oferi pacienţilor detalii suplimentare legate de diferitele tipuri de patologii, de a limita doza de iradiere, precum şi de a eficientiza la maximum preluarea solicitărilor de explorări imagistice din ce în ce mai numeroase şi mai complexe. Pentru a răspunde optim fluxului din ce în ce mai mare de pacienti, Institutul de Fonoaudiologie şi Chirurgie Funcţională O.R.L.–„Prof. Dr. Dorin Hociotă”, trateaza cazuri extrem de complexe, cu patologii intricate, în multe cazuri cu simptomatologie acută tip stroke/pseudostroke, suprapusă unei patologii oncologice sau cronice preexistente, sunt imperios necesare lărgirea şi diversificarea platoului tehnic din cadrul Laboratorului de Radiologie si Imagistica medicala, care să permită acte medicale complete şi fără fisuri, de la un diagnostic rapid conform maximei "TIME IS BRAIN" la un tratament optimizat, care să scurteze durata de spitalizare şi să permită pacientului o recuperare totală. In vederea imbunatatirii sigurantei actului medical, a fost identificat ca fiind necesar achiziționarea unui „Sistem de imagistica medicala” pentru Institutul de Fonoaudiologie si Chirurgie Functionala ORL, ”Prof. dr. Dorin Hociota” constand intr-un Sistem de imagistica medicala RMN 3T si serviciile conexe care contau in amenajarea spatiului interior si exterior necesar instalarii, punerii in functiune si exploatarii echipamentului. Termenul limita pana la care se pot solicita clarificari la documentatia de atribuire: Operatorii economici interesati de procedura vor solicita clarificari sau informatii suplimentare in legatura cu documentatia de atribuire cu 11 zile inainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor. In conformitate cu prevederile art.161 din legea 98/2016, autoritatea contractanta va raspunde in mod clar si complet solicitarilor de clarificare/informtiilor suplimentare in legatura cu documentatia de atribuire in a 3-a zi inainte de termenul limita stabilit pentru depunerea ofertelor in anuntul de participare .

title: 36 WG Vehicle Removal and Towing Services IDIQ (Andersen AFB, Guam)
description: VII. AMENDMENTS 9/17/2026 - Amendment 0001 The purpose of this amendment is to: 1. Provide the Government's responses to industry questions. 2. Amended Solicitation - FA524026Q0041. I. DESCRIPTION This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with RFO Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number FA524026Q0041 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for vehicle removal and towing services on Andersen Air Force Base (AAFB), Guam. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. II. CONTRACT LINE-ITEM NUMBERS (CLINS) are firm-fixed price (FFP) as shown in the attached SF1449 titled Solicitation - FA524026Q0041 and Attachment 2 - Price List. III. DESCRIPTION OF SERVICE The primary objective of this contract is to provide comprehensive commercial vehicle removal and towing services for abandoned Privately Owned Vehicles (POVs) and associated parts and Government-Owned Vehicles (GOVs) and equipment on Andersen Air Force Base (AAFB), Guam. The Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, and transportation necessary to complete the work as defined in the Performance Work Statement (PWS). Services include 1) Abandoned Privately Owned Vehicle (POV) and associated parts Removal: Complete wrecker and towing services for the removal of abandoned vehicles and associated parts. 2) Government-Owned Vehicle (GOV) and Equipment Removal and Transport to Defense Logistics Agency Disposition Services (DLA-DS), Naval Base Guam (NBG): The removal and transportation of GOVs and equipment from AAFB to DLA-DS facility at NBG. IV. PLACE AND PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE Place of Performance: The work will be performed at AAFB and NBG, Guam. Period of Performance: The period of performance shall occur during the ordering period of five years with a total of no more than five (5) years and six (6) months. The period of performance for any individual order shall not exceed six (6) months beyond the last day of the ordering period in which it is placed; the established rates for that ordering period shall apply to that order. In no event shall any period of performance extend more than six (6) months beyond the expiration of the final ordering period; resulting in a maximum contract lifecycle of five (5) years and six (6) months. The ordering period concludes at the end of five (5) years or when the cumulative value of all issued orders reaches the IDIQ ceiling, whichever comes first. V. SOLICITATION PROVISIONS AND CONTRACT CLAUSES The full list of provisions and clauses applicable to this acquisition are included in the attached SF1449 titled Solicitation - FA524026Q0041. VI. QUOTE DUE DATE/TIME: To be considered for award, quotes must be emailed to: elena.gifford.1@us.af.mil AND louella.navarrete@us.af.mil no later than 1:00 P.M. Chamorro Standard Time (ChST) on 22 September 2026. (Note: .zip files are not an acceptable format for the Air Force Network. It is the vendor�s responsibility to confirm receipt of quote.)

title: UPDATED: 9/8/2026 - 30888PR260000012 - USCG STATION SAN DIEGO - KITCHEN RENOVATION - CONSTRUCTION
description: Solicitation: Station San Diego Kitchen Renovation Set-Aside: Total Small Business Set-Aside (FAR Subpart 19.5) Location: USCG Station San Diego, Building F (Kitchen), 2170 N. Harbor Drive, San Diego, CA 92101 Evaluation: FAR 52.212-2 - Relevant Past Performance and Price will be used to evaluate bids Important Dates Questions Due: September 16, 2026 Proposals Due: September 21, 2026, by 11:59 PM Eastern Time 1. Project Background and Objective The U.S. Coast Guard requires complete renovations of the kitchen at Station San Diego (Building F). The Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, transportation, tools, materials, and supervision necessary to modernize the kitchen space. 2. Scope of Work (Summary) - Please review the attached Statement of Work (SOW) for full technical requirements, safety standards, and applicable codes. The Contractor is responsible for the demolition of existing materials and the installation of new cabinetry, countertops, appliances, and fixtures. Key tasks include: Electrical & Plumbing: Install three (3) new electrical outlets along the SAR Locker Room Wall. Remove the existing garbage disposal and sump pump; furnish and install a new garbage disposal, sump pump, and single-basin stainless steel sink. Cabinetry & Countertops: Furnish and install new kitchen cabinets and countertops along the Window Wall and SAR Locker Room Wall. Install a new countertop for the Kitchen Island. Appliances: Furnish and install a new stainless-steel dishwasher, stove, microwave, and a portable stainless-steel refrigerator. Finishing & Painting: Prepare all wall surfaces (patching, sanding, priming) and paint the entire kitchen space. Testing & Commissioning: Verify load capacity on new breakers, pressure test plumbing lines, and test all appliance functions. 3. Site Conditions & Hazardous Materials An Asbestos and Lead Survey was conducted for this facility (AESS Job No. 26-092). Asbestos: No asbestos was detected in the Station's kitchen (Building F). Lead: Lead was detected at very low concentrations (<0.00151% to <0.00238% by weight) on the east and south walls. Handling & Disposal: Debris and waste generated from the removal of lead-containing materials must be evaluated for appropriate disposal classification (TCLP or TTLC) prior to off-site disposal. Government dumpsters shall not be used. 4. Period of Performance and Hours All work shall be completed within 60 calendar days from the issuance of the written Notice to Proceed (NTP). Work hours are Monday through Friday, 0900 to 1500 hours, excluding federal holidays. Any disruption to utilities must be coordinated at least 72 hours in advance. 5. Wage Determinations This project is subject to the Davis-Bacon Act (FAR 52.222-6). Prevailing wages for San Diego County, CA, apply. See the attached General Decision Wage Determination. 6. Proposal Submission Requirements To be considered for award, interested offerors must submit the following documents with their proposal: Product Data Sheets & Warranties: For all appliances (dishwasher, stove, microwave, refrigerator), sink, garbage disposal, sump pump, cabinetry, and countertops. Samples: Paint color, countertop, and cabinet finish samples or spec sheets (must be provided for USCG review prior to installation). Safety Plans: An Activity Hazard Analysis (AHA) & Accident Prevention Plan (APP) detailing Cal/OSHA compliance for lead-containing materials and general construction safety. Technical Plan: Detailed technical plan outlining the project schedule from the post-award walk-through to construction completion. Past Performance & Licensing: Relevant past performance examples and proof of valid professional and trade licenses (plumbing, electrical). Pricing: Transparent pricing sheet breaking down labor, materials, waste disposal, and the total proposed cost. Attachments Statement of Work (SOW) - Station San Diego Kitchen Renovation Davis-Bacon Wage Determination - San Diego, CA Asbestos and Lead Survey Report - AESS Job No. 26-092 All questions should be directed to the Contracting Officer prior to the Q&A deadline.

title: Reusable Energy Absorbing Layer (REAL) and Reusable Universal Skid Board (RUSB), Yokota AB, Japan
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD SINGLE SOURCE The 374th Contracting Squadron, Yokota Air Base, Japan, intends to award a single source purchase order to Quality Research, Development & Consulting, Inc. (QRDC), Excelsior, MN, to procure the Reusable Energy Absorbing Layer (REAL) and Reusable Universal Skid Board (RUSB) items. The REAL and RUSB system has been tested and approved for airdrops by U.S. Air Force. QRDC is the sole provider of the REAL and RUSB system. Item(s) to be obtained is as follows: Line Item 1 Item: Container Delivery System (CDS) 4242S100BSbBe Description: CDS 4242S100BSbBe = 9 REAL06M12 + 6 REAL23M126 + 1 REAL04M06 + RUSB03 1" black + Belt , package is NOT waterproof. Quantity: 7 Line Item 2 Item: Low-Cost Low-Altitude (LCLA) 2442S075BSblBe Description: LCLA 2442S075BSblBe = 6 REALM12 + 2 REALM126 + 0 REALM06 + RUSB04 0.75" black + Belt Quantity: 7 Line Item 3 Item: Shipping Description: Direct Shipping to Yokota Air Base, Japan Quantity: 1 Lot THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTATION. This is a notice of intent to award a single source purchase order as authorized by Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) 12.102(a). The anticipated award date is 30 September 2026. Again, this is not a request for competitive quotation. However, all interested parties who believe they can meet the requirements are invited to submit in writing complete information describing their ability to provide the products/services listed above, including the company�s name, point of contact, address, phone number, UEI number, TAX ID, and CAGE code. A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. The closing date for this notice is 22 September 2026 at 02:00 PM (Japan Standard Time). For information regarding this purchase, please contact 2d Lt Janrae Zedric A. Abella at janrae_zedric.abella.1@us.af.mil and Mr. Yuma Kato at yuma.kato.jp@us.af.mil. Notice to Offeror(s)/Supplier(s): Funds are not presently available for this effort. No award will be made under this solicitation until funds are available. The Government reserves the right to cancel this solicitation, either before or after the closing date. In the event the Government cancels this solicitation, the Government has no obligation to reimburse an offeror for any costs.

title: Replace DSN-HDD Generator for 78th Signal Battalion, Camp Zama, Japan.
description: The Government intends to solicit this requirement IAW RFO FAR 12.201-1 for firm-fixed price contract to purchase and install a DSN-HDD Generator 78th Signal Battalion, Camp Zama, Japan. The government anticipates posting the solicitation on or around August 18, 2026. The contractor shall provide all necessary personnel, supervision, management, tools, equipment, transportation, materials, and any other items or services necessary to decommission, remove, dispose, and install a 150 KVA/50 Hz generator. Any damages caused to U.S. Government property during performing this contract shall be restored, replaced and/or repaired to its original condition at no additional cost to the U.S. Government. The contractor shall perform testing and handover to ensure all items are functioning properly. The contractor shall perform in accordance with (IAW) Performance Work Statement (PWS). Notes: Note 1: This project will be performed in its entirety in the country of Japan. The successful offeror must have valid licenses to meet the requirement in the country of Japan. Offerors must have a Japanese CAGE code.

title: Servis, údržba a oprava-manipulátor teleskopický
description: Předmětem této veřejné zakázky malého rozsahu (dále též „VZMR“) je služba: „Servis, údržba a oprava-manipulátor teleskopický“ pro VÚ 6624 Olomouc dále specifikovaná v zadávací dokumentaci této VZMR. Součástí zadávací dokumentace je „Příloha 1 k Výzvě_Cenová specifikace díla“ (spotřební koš), kde zadavatel požaduje její vyplnění ve žlutě vyznačených místech, podepsání oprávněnou osobou a opětovné vložení (nejlépe ve formátu „pdf“ a také v původním formátu) do el. nástroje NEN jako součást nabídky. Cenu, která byla vypočtena na základě vyplnění tabulky v „Příloze 1 k Výzvě_Cenová specifikace díla“ zadá dodavatel (dále „dodavatel“=„uchazeč, účastník“) přesně bez zaokrouhlování do předmětu el. nástroje NEN jako nabídku. Součástí zadávací dokumentace je také „Příloha 2 k Výzvě_Návrh Rámcové dohody“, kde zadavatel požaduje její vyplnění v červeně vyznačených místech, podepsání oprávněnou osobou a opětovné vložení do el. nástroje NEN jako součást nabídky (nejlépe ve formátu „pdf“ a také v původním formátu). Zadavatel požaduje záruční dobu služby nejméně 24 měsíců na nové ND a 6 měsíců na práci u dané techniky. Součástí nabídky budou také přílohy prokazující kvalifikaci dodavatele. Nedoložení kvalifikace ani po opětovné výzvě bude ze strany zadavatele bráno jako nesplnění základních předpokladů a tato nabídka bude vyřazena před hodnocením nabídek. Dodavatel nabídkou podanou v tomto výběrovém řízení automaticky souhlasí se všemi vypsanými podmínkami tohoto výběrového řízení. Nabídková cena bude zadavatelem považována za nejvýše přípustnou a bude zahrnovat veškeré náklady dodavatele s poskytnutím služby. Dodavatel si řádně zkontroluje cenu zadanou do el. nástroje NEN. Tato cena nemůže být upravena ani v případě početní chyby. Nabídky dodavatelů budou hodnoceny na základě nabízené ceny za splnění kompletního rozsahu zakázky při dodržení požadavků výběrového řízení. Po uveřejnění „Výzvy k podání nabídky včetně zadávací dokumentace“ na profilu zadavatele běží lhůta 3 pracovních dnů pro možnost podání stížnosti z důvodu nesouhlasu se zadávacími podmínkami. Vyhodnocení veřejné zakázky proběhne do 30 pracovních dnů od lhůty pro ukončení podání nabídek. Po odeslání „Oznámení o výběru dodavatele“ běží lhůta 3 pracovních dnů pro možnost odvolání proti výsledku výběrového řízení.

description: The purpose of this RFQ is to solicit quotes for Shure ANX4 Incremental Channel Expansion Licenses and UniFi Indoor Cat6A CMP cable for FEMA Region VI Federal Regional Center and the Texas Room located in the Russell Newman Building. description: American Embassy, New Delhi (India) invites you to participate and submit your best competitive offer for �Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of AV Equipment� at American Center Building, 24-KG Marg, Connaught Place, New Delhi (India). Location: American Center Building, 24-Kasturba Gandhi Marg, Connaught Place, New Delhi-110001. Date: Wednesday 16th September 2026 at 2:00 p.m. Time: Kindly reach latest by 1:45 p.m. for security screening. Please ensure provided visitor name must be the same listed on their issued Govt. photo Id. Only those participants are allowed to attend site inspection who have given confirmation via email. Late response will not be considered. Registration for the site visit: Interested bidders who desire to participate in the site visit, should send their confirmation via return email to mehtan@state.gov along with providing full name of the visitor latest by 14th September 2026. Please ensure provided visitor name must be the same listed on their issued Govt. photo Id. Only those participants are allowed to attend site inspection who have given confirmation via email. Late response will not be considered. Quotation Submission: Deadline: On or before 22nd September 2026 (India Time). All quotations must be received by this deadline. No quote will be accepted after this time. Submission Method: Your quotation must be submitted electronically at newdelhibids@state.gov. Quotation submitted to any other e-mail address will not be considered for evaluation. Please refer to the solicitation for complete details. Subject Line: �Solicitation-191N6526Q0115 for �Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Audio- Visual Equipment. Important: Do not send quotations via courier or to any other email address. Quotations incomplete or received at any other address or received after the given deadline will be handled per FAR provision 52.212-1(f). The file size must not exceed 10MB. If the file size exceeds 10MB, the submission must be made in separate files and attached to separate emails with less than 10MB each. Questions/Clarifications: All requests for clarification must be submitted in writing via email to mehtan@state.gov by 1400 hrs (India Time) 15th September 2026. Responses will be provided to all contractors who express interest in doing business with the U.S. Government. Questions received after the deadline will not be answered. Basis for Award: The U.S. Government intends to award a contract/purchase order to the responsible offeror submitting an acceptable quotation at the lowest price. Required Submission Elements: To be considered for award, offerors must submit the following: Section-B � Prices/Costs Section K � Representations, Certifications, and Other Statements of Offerors or Quote Additional information required in Section L Proof of SAM Registration Offerors must be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) at https://www.sam.gov prior to submitting and offer. If registration cannot be completed before award, the contractor must be registered within 30 days after award or at least three days prior to submission of the invoice, whichever occurs first. Offerors are strongly encouraged to register immediately if they intend to respond to this requirement.

title: Test Pilot School Curriculum Development and Analysis Support
description: The United States Air Force (USAF) Test Pilot School (TPS) requires Curriculum Development and Analysis Support. This is the official synopsis and solicitation for the Curriculum Development and Analysis Support. The USAF Test Pilot School is interested in a non-personnel service contract to be awarded with a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) structure to the vendor who can meet all the needs of the Curriculum Development and Analysis Support. Please see the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS) for more details. Interested parties must be able to meet the following requirements: (i) This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products prepared in accordance with the format in R-FAR 6.102(b), as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. Offerors are required to submit with their quote enough information for the Government to evaluate the requirements detailed in this combined synopsis/solicitation. Offerors shall submit quotes via email, please note the maximum file size is 10MB. Emails over this file size will not be received. Submit only written offers; oral offers will not be accepted. Any anticipated awardee must be able to meet the specific flying qualifications and provide the following: The Contractor should be considered a world-recognized expert in the field of flight sciences with a minimum of 25 years of professional flight test experience in military aircraft. The Contractor shall have an earned master's degree or equivalent in Aerospace Engineering or a related field from an accredited United States university. The Contractor shall have experience developing flight envelope expansion instruction and with envelope expansion flight instruction. The Contractor shall also have experience developing variable-stability instruction and instructing in variable-stability aircraft. The Contractor shall have experience with AI controller integration into manned air platforms. The Contractor shall have demonstrated the ability to work with students to plan, execute, analyze, and report on flight test research and development programs. The Contractor shall have extensive experience teaching flight test academics in a formal classroom, having achieved the full academic/faculty rank of professor (or equivalent) or higher. The Contractor shall provide all management, personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to perform curriculum development analysis and support. title: „Zámečnické a přidružené práce v bytech a nebytových prostorách domů MČ Brno – Líšeň 2026-2029“
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je provádění zámečnických a souvisejících stavebních prací v bytech a nebytových prostorách domů ve správě městské části Brno–Líšeň. Jedná se zejména o opravy, montáž, demontáž a údržbu zárubní, dveří, dveřního kování, zámků, zábradlí, mříží a dalších zámečnických prvků, včetně souvisejících dodávek a pomocných prací podle položkového rozpočtu a požadavků zadavatele. Účelem veřejné zakázky je zajištění řádné, průběžné a efektivní správy a údržby bytového fondu ve správě městské části Brno–Líšeň. Cílem veřejné zakázky je uzavření rámcové dohody na období 3 let s jedním vybraným dodavatelem. Jednotlivá plnění budou realizována na základě písemných objednávek podle podmínek stanovených v rámcové dohodě a v této zadávací dokumentaci.

title: Výroba, dodání a montáž bezpečnostních okenních mříží v ZZC Bělá Jezová
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je výroba a montáž 79 ks snímatelných bezpečnostních okenních mříží na vnější části otvorových výplní (oken) objektů č. 2 a č. 3 v Zařízení pro zajištění cizinců Bělá-Jezová, včetně manipulace a dopravy.

title: Svoz odpadu v obci Šanov
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je zajištění pravidelného sběru a svozu komunálních odpadů na území obce Šanov, zejména obsluha nádob umístěných u rodinných domů a obsluha kontejnerů umístěných na separačních stanovištích. Předmět plnění zahrnuje zejména: • pravidelný svoz směsného komunálního odpadu (TKO) z nádob u rodinných domů, • pravidelný svoz plastu z nádob u rodinných domů, • pravidelný svoz papíru z nádob u rodinných domů, • pravidelný svoz papíru, plastu, skla a biologicky rozložitelného odpadu (BIO) z kontejnerů o objemu 1 100 l umístěných na separačních stanovištích na území obce, • přepravu svezeného odpadu do zadavatelem určeného koncového zařízení, • zajištění veškeré potřebné svozové techniky, personálu a souvisejících činností, • vedení elektronické evidence provedených svozů a obsloužených nádob v rozsahu požadovaném zadávací dokumentací.

title: Stavby veřejného osvětlení 2026 II (PD+IČ+DP)
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky malého rozsahu je vypracování projektových dokumentací pro vydání rozhodnutí o povolení záměru a dokumentací pro provádění stavby, výkon dozoru projektanta a výkon inženýrské činnosti do vydání pravomocných rozhodnutí či jiných opatření stavebního úřadu pro připravované stavby veřejného osvětlení: - Rekonstrukce VO Frýdecká úsek ul. Mostní – JIP - Rekonstrukce VO oblast Nezvalovo náměstí - Rekonstrukce VO oblast Bedrnova - Zimmlerova - Rekonstrukce VO oblast Horní - Rekonstrukce napájecích kabelů Hlučínská

title: Pořízení nemocničních lůžek pro oddělení následné péče nemocnice Kutná Hora
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je dodávka 10 ks elektricky polohovatelných nemocničních lůžek v rozsahu 3 lůžek s laterárním náklonem a 7 lůžek bez laterárního náklonu pro oddělení následné péče nemocnice Kutná Hora, včetně plně integrovaného aktivního antidekubitního systému včetně aktivních antidekubitních matrací.
